images.caption: Figure 1:ConceptTimetargets accuracy, interpretability, and calibrated abstention through a single self-supervised primitive.Left, existing methods emphasize different goals.Right, 4 segments (A-D) and their preceding context. Raw-shape space conflates A and B (both end calm) and splits C from D. Predictive-geometry space, spanned by predictive variance and NLL, collapses A, C, and D as expectation is satisfied and isolates B as asurprise. Concepts grounded in deviation from prediction, therefore, distinguish dynamical regimes that shape-based vocabularies cannot.
